tried.name: today (replica)
tried.idea: b9bef5f's freeShapeRun for the bodies copied into a method with knobs (B/methods/var.mjs, cfg {}), on an engine copy whose solver options are opt-in (B/make-eng.mjs: noCov, covOnly, fwd). It must match the engine's own search, so that the variants differ from today only by their knobs.
tried.results: Identical to the pilot's records on all 22 sub-screen runs (check-replica.mjs: every refinement's evaluations and χ², the outcome and the χ²). 88 881 evaluations, the same as the pilot. Its search ran 1.046× the pilot's wall time: the load was heavier, with 2 of our processes beside another agent's 2–3.
tried.verdict: Valid reference. It is also the in-process wall-time pair for nocov and fwd (tag sub1).

tried.name: nocov (1)
tried.idea: No covariance in intermediate refinements: no closing evaluation and no central Jacobian at the end of each brief, full, polish, exact, held and refit refinement. The returned fit's covariance is made once, central (covOnly).
tried.results: Sub-screen, 22 runs: 80 678 against 88 881 evaluations (0.908×; median per run 0.900; 0.89–0.93 by class). Wall time 0.915× against the today replica in the same processes. Outcome the same on 22/22. Every minimum identical to today's: same Δ, no solid changed, the same accuracy. The covariance costs about 20 evaluations a refinement (1 + 2 per non-linear parameter), which is 10 % of a brief.
tried.verdict: Kept: pure saving, nothing it leaves out was read. It is included in every later variant.

tried.name: fwd (1)+(2)
tried.idea: Forward differences in every refinement of the search: one displaced point per non-linear column, with the state's pattern at v reused; backward at an upper bound. No intermediate covariance. The returned fit's covariance once, central.
tried.results: Sub-screen, 22 runs: 0.527× evaluations (median per run 0.518) and 0.593× wall time, paired in the same processes. Outcome the same 22/22, no solid changed, reach 22/22 (today 21/22). Iterations per refinement unchanged: brief 7.9 against 7.9, full 11.4 against 11.5. Full screening set, 77 runs: 161 197 against 307 235 evaluations (0.525×; median 0.519). Outcome the same on 76/77: ellipsoid-P4m-on went from held to free, at a free minimum 11.6 χ²_ν (today's χ²_ν) below today's held fit. Solid changed on 2/63 kept runs. Reach 57/63 against today's 55/63 (best known over all methods). Medians: worst extent +42 % (90 % +290 %), as today; thinnest +22 % against +20 %; axis 7.2° against 6.8°. Spheres 11/11 the same.
tried.verdict: Kept: the core of the gain.

tried.name: fwdC: the central pass (2)
tried.idea: The user's condition: the minimum fwd returns is refined once more with central differences, with its covariance. This replaces the covariance-only pass. Both accountings come from one run: fwd = the run without the central pass; fwdC = the run without the covOnly.
tried.results: 63 kept runs on the 77. Cost 44 evaluations median (IQR 36–58, range 28–159) against 18 for the covariance alone, so +24 a run: 0.531× against 0.525×. Wall 0.599× against 0.594× (vs pilot). One iteration median. χ² lowered by 0.0003 χ²_ν median, at most 0.61. Four runs moved by more than 0.1 and none by more than 1: box-P4mmm-generic 0.61, sqbox-P6mmm-generic 0.25, ellipsoid-P-3-generic 0.17, box-Pmmm-on 0.14, all free fits. Extents moved by at most 4.45 % (spheroid-P2m-on); in every other run under 0.4 %. Axes moved by at most 1.7°. No outcome changed.
tried.verdict: Kept, as the user asked. It costs 1.2 % of fwd and does not move the minimum except in flat valleys along free extents.

tried.name: fwdH (3)
tried.idea: Held lattice frames de-duplicated by the harness's canonical(). A frame whose canonical form (R and dims) repeats an earlier one modulo the Laue class and the body's symmetry is not refined. Measured two ways: for real ('canon'), and as flags in fwd ('count': refined anyway and marked, so fwdH* = fwd less the marked evaluations).
tried.results: Pilot logs: the 29 repeated frames end at the same χ² and evaluations as the first (to 0.01). The refinement is equivariant under the class's rotations. 77 runs: 29 of 124 held refinements repeat a frame modulo the class. None repeat in −1, 2/m or mmm; the repeats are 3–6 per class in the others (6/mmm 6, m−3 5, −3m 5). Saving 2178 evaluations, 28 a run, 0.7 % of today (0.525× → 0.518×). Real against derived on 52 rows: 117 364 against 117 372 evaluations; outcomes and minima identical. Sub-screen wall 0.559× against fwd's 0.593×, but from another process. Round 1's axis-signs dedupe would catch 19 of the 29 (pilot reading).
tried.verdict: Kept: free, and no result changes by construction.

tried.name: fwdB (2')
tried.idea: Forward differences only in the 8-iteration briefs; central differences in the full, polish, exact, held and refit refinements.
tried.results: Not run. fwd already reached today's minima on 22/22 with the same iteration counts, so central refinements after the briefs could only cost more.
tried.verdict: Dropped before running, for the reason stated.

tried.name: symA (4)
tried.idea: Symmetry cuts the starts: keep only the class's distinct low-index starts, 1 + 2 × families, with no random fill. lowIndexAxes already gives one axis per Laue family, and the plate and needle along a family are not equivalent, so the only redundant starts are the random fill to 11. That fill exists only where the class has fewer than 5 families: −3m, 6/m, 6/mmm (4 families: 9 + 2 random) and m−3, m−3m (3 families: 7 + 4 random). In the other six classes nothing changes. Run with fwd, the central pass and canon.
tried.results: Sub-screen (10 runs of the five classes): 0.442× against fwdH's 0.517×. All 35 runs of those classes: 54 510 against 63 894 evaluations for fwdH* (−15 %). By class (bestC): −3m 0.45, 6/m 0.52, 6/mmm 0.47, m−3 0.42, m−3m 0.36 of today, against fwd's 0.52, 0.54, 0.54, 0.57, 0.53. Outcome the same 35/35, including 5/5 early rejections. Reach 24/27 against 25/27: cylinder-Pm-3m-on Δ 2.6, in its free fit only; the reported held fit is identical to today's. One solid changed: sphere-P6mmm-1, a sphere kept as a box under texture, by 1.2 % and 2.7°. Pilot reading: random starts reached the 3 best briefs in 17 of 35 runs and were the best brief in 4. The deterministic ends nevertheless reached the same minima in 24 of 27.
tried.verdict: Kept in the recommended combination. Its gain is limited to five classes.

tried.name: symC (4)
tried.idea: Random starts restricted to the fundamental zone, with the count scaled to what the zone leaves room for. A random start is drawn as today but kept only when its most telling axis lies at least 20° from every earlier start's, modulo the class's rotations (axes without sign; for a cylinder or spheroid, the axis alone). At most today's count, and 200 draws a slot.
tried.results: Fill kept: 2 in −3m and 6/m (17 draws), 1 in 6/mmm and 1 in cubic (215–229 draws). Sub-screen, 10 runs: 0.488× against symA's 0.442× and fwdH's 0.517×. Outcome 10/10. It missed the same run as symA by more: cylinder-Pm-3m-on Δ 3.75, again in the free fit only. On one run it found the best: box-Pm-3-near Δ 0.00 against 0.16–0.19.
tried.verdict: Rejected. It costs more than symA and does not recover the miss: the fill's value was not coverage of the zone.

tried.name: fullDrop (4b)
tried.idea: Full refinements only from distinct brief ends. A brief end among the 3 best that is the same solid as a better one (sameSolid modulo the class and the body: 8°, e^0.25) is not refined fully. Prompted by the pilot logs: 78 of 210 full refinements started from a duplicate, and 69 of those 78 ended at the same solid as the first.
tried.results: Sub-screen: 0.482× against fwdH's 0.519×. Reach 21/22: ellipsoid-P-3-generic Δ 1.2, its solid changed. On the 77, inside 'cuts', 80 full refinements were dropped in 52 runs. Those runs carry every serious loss: box-Pmmm-on Δ 21 → 191 χ²_ν (solid changed 21 %), box-P4mmm-generic 0.6 → 3.3, ellipsoid-P-3-generic 0.4 → 1.2, and spheroid-P2m-on's solid changed by 46 % at Δ 0.19.
tried.verdict: Rejected. A brief end after 8 iterations is not converged, and two ends 8°/28 % apart can lead to different minima.

tried.name: fullRep (4b)
tried.idea: Round 1's dedupFull: the duplicate brief end is replaced by the next distinct one, so 3 full refinements are kept.
tried.results: Sub-screen: 0.563× against fwdH's 0.519× (+8 %). Reach 22/22, the same as fwdH. One solid changed.
tried.verdict: Rejected for this track: it adds cost and buys no reach here.

tried.name: cuts (finalist)
tried.idea: fwd + nocov + the central pass + held canon + symA + fullDrop: every cut together.
tried.results: 77 runs: 139 476 evaluations with the central pass (0.454×; 0.447× without). Wall 0.508× against the pilot. Outcome the same 76/77 (the same ellipsoid-P4m-on change). Solid changed 7/63. Reach 54/63, with box-Pmmm-on at Δ 190.8. The losses are attributed by run: the dropped full refinements cause all but cylinder-Pm-3m-on, which is symA's.
tried.verdict: Rejected because of fullDrop. Without fullDrop it becomes 'best'.

tried.name: best (finalist, recommended)
tried.idea: fwd + nocov + the central pass + held canon + symA. It is one configuration. It was run as symA in the 5 classes whose starts it changes (35 runs) and as fwdH in the 6 where it changes none (42 runs: 12 in sub2, 30 in held30). All are real runs.
tried.results: See 'best'.
tried.verdict: Recommended.

tried.name: profile (mechanism check, not a variant)
tried.idea: Time spent inside phasePattern, and inside the Jacobians against elsewhere, for today and fwd. Engine copy hp/: a timer around phasePattern and a flag inside the Jacobians, with no arithmetic change.
tried.results: Over 3 rows, 96–98 % of the search's time is in pattern evaluations; the work outside them is 1.6–2.8 % (today) and 2.3–4.4 % (fwd). An evaluation outside a Jacobian (trial step, FCJ audit, covariance) costs 1.5–2.5× a Jacobian column: box-Pm-3-near 20.1 against 13.5 ms, ellcyl-P2m-generic 48.6 against 19.5 ms. On box-Pm-3-near those evaluations are 16 % of today's but 27 % of fwd's, and the mean per evaluation rises from 14.5 to 17.0 ms.

result.best:
The recommended combination is forward differences in every refinement of the search, no intermediate covariance, the returned fit refined once more with central differences (its covariance from that pass), held frames de-duplicated by canonical(), and only the class's distinct low-index starts (no random fill). That gives 7 starts in m−3 and m−3m, 9 in −3m, 6/m and 6/mmm, and 11 as today in the other six classes.

Full 77-run screening set, against today's run in the pilot:
- **Evaluations:** 151 381 against 307 235 (0.493×; median per run 0.497). The parts: forward differences + no covariance 0.525×; central pass +0.006×; held dedupe −0.007×; symmetric starts −0.031×.
- **Search time:** 43.1 s against 76.9 s a run, so 55.3 against 98.7 min summed. That is 0.560× the pilot's wall time, measured under a heavier load (our 2 processes beside another agent's 2–3 on 4 vCPUs). Against the today replica on the 22 sub-screen runs it is 0.545×, from separate processes. Forward differences alone, paired in the same processes, give 0.593×.
- **By class, evaluations / wall against the pilot:** −1 0.50/0.58, 2/m 0.50/0.55, mmm 0.52/0.59, 4/m 0.51/0.57, 4/mmm 0.58/0.63, −3 0.53/0.56, −3m 0.45/0.52, 6/m 0.52/0.61, 6/mmm 0.47/0.53, m−3 0.42/0.45, m−3m 0.36/0.40.
- **Outcome:** the same on 76/77, including all 11 spheres (3 kept, 8 rejected) and all 7 early rejections.
  - The one change: ellipsoid-P4m-on went from held to free. Forward differences found a free minimum 11.6 χ²_ν below today's held fit; it is less accurate (longest +33 % against +14 %, axis 4.5° against 0.0°).
- **Reach** (Δ ≤ 1 against the best exact χ² of all methods run): 56/63 against today's 55/63.
  - Gained: box-P4mmm-generic, ellcyl-P6m-generic, ellipsoid-P4m-on.
  - Lost: cylinder-Pm-3m-on Δ 2.6 and sqbox-P4mmm-near Δ 2.7. Both are free fits beside a held result identical to today's.
  - The reported fit's χ² is within 0.1 χ²_ν of today's in 55/63 kept runs, lower in 5 (by 0.25–11.6 χ²_ν) and higher in 3: box-Pmmm-on +1.95, ellcyl-P-3-on +0.83, ellcyl-P-3m1-near +0.16.
- **Solids changed** (more than 5 % in an extent or 2° in the axis): 3 of 63.
  - ellipsoid-P4m-on, the outcome change above.
  - ellcyl-P-3m1-near: an equivalent minimum with the height on another extent, Δ 0.00 against today's 0.03.
  - sphere-P6mmm-1: kept as a box under texture, moved by 1.2 % and 2.7°.
- **Accuracy medians:** worst extent +42 % (90 %: +290 %) as today; thinnest +22 % against +20 %; axis 6.6° against 6.8°.
- **(5), round 1 checked in every class:** forward differences + no intermediate covariance (with the central pass) give 0.50–0.58× the evaluations, 7 runs per class, confirming the halving. Wall time does not halve: 0.56–0.72× against the pilot and 0.52–0.71× paired (2 runs per class). Cubic reproduces round 1 (m−3m 0.53× evaluations, 0.60–0.63× wall).
result.why:
**Where the evaluations go.** Today's search spends 60 % of its evaluations in the 11 briefs (8 iterations each, about 220 evaluations), 23 % in the 3 full refinements, about 10 % in the held frames, and the rest in polish, exact and refit. An iteration is a Jacobian (2 evaluations per non-linear column, central) plus about 1.2 trial steps. Every refinement also ended with a covariance: 1 + 2 evaluations per non-linear parameter, about 10 % of a brief.

**(1) No intermediate covariance.** The covariance is made after convergence and only the returned fit's is read. Dropping it cannot change any step: 0.908× evaluations and identical minima on 22/22 runs.

**(2) Forward differences.** They halve each Jacobian.
- The iteration counts did not change at the median (brief 7.9, full 11.4 against 11.5), and the minima were today's on 22/22 runs.
- Where the path diverged, the fit ended at the same χ² (cylinder-P4mmm-on: 45 against 32 full iterations).
- The ratio by class is 0.49–0.58. It is highest in 4/mmm and m−3, where trial steps and audits weigh more in a run.

**Why wall time falls less than evaluations.** 96–98 % of the search's time is in pattern evaluations. An evaluation outside a Jacobian (trial step, FCJ audit, covariance) costs 1.5–2.5× a Jacobian column: 20.1 against 13.5 ms, 48.6 against 19.5 ms. Forward differences halve only the cheap Jacobian evaluations, so the dear ones become a larger share (16 % → 27 %) and the mean cost per evaluation rises by 10–20 %. The likely cause is caches the engine keeps when only one parameter moves; this was inferred, not traced.

**The central pass.** On a forward-difference minimum it costs 1 iteration (44 evaluations median) and moves χ² by 0.0003 χ²_ν median: the forward and central minima are the same point. Its few moves (at most 0.61 χ²_ν, 4.5 % in an extent, 1.7° in an axis) are all free fits in flat valleys, where the shift test had stopped. Its marginal cost over the covariance it replaces is 24 evaluations a run.

**(3) Held frames.**
- The refinement is equivariant under the class's rotations, so equivalent frames end at the same χ² in the same number of evaluations; skipping them changes nothing.
- They exist only where a rotation of the class maps one candidate frame onto another (in 4/m and above): 29 of 124 held refinements on the 77 runs, none in −1, 2/m or mmm.
- Because the held refinements are a small stage, the saving is small: 28 evaluations a run.

**(4) Symmetry and starts.**
- lowIndexAxes already gives one axis per Laue family, and a plate and a needle along one family are different starts, so no deterministic start is equivalent to another.
- The only symmetry redundancy is the random fill to 11. It exists only where the class has fewer than 5 low-index families: 2 random starts in −3m, 6/m and 6/mmm, 4 in cubic. That is how higher symmetry already lowers the number of distinct starts.
- Dropping the fill saves 15 % of the search in those five classes (36–52 % of today's evaluations there). It cost one free-fit miss of 2.6 χ²_ν beside an identical held result.
- Restricting the fill to the fundamental zone at 20° from every start gives no better reach and costs more than dropping it. A uniform random rotation is already uniform in the zone modulo symmetry, and the fill's random shapes found basins (44 in the pilot logs) whose minima the deterministic starts reached anyway in 24 of 27 runs.

**(4b) Full refinements from distinct brief ends.** The 3 best brief ends are often duplicates by an 8°/28 % test (52 of 77 runs). Dropping the duplicates looks safe on the pilot logs (69 of 78 ended alike) but costs reach on the 77, up to 191 χ²_ν on box-Pmmm-on. Briefs of 8 iterations are not converged, and ends that close can still lead to different minima.
open: Wall time was measured under load: another agent's 2–3 processes ran beside our 2 on 4 vCPUs. Only fwd against today is paired in the same process (22 runs). The recommended combination's wall time (0.545–0.560×) comes from separate processes or against the pilot's quieter run. A paired timing on an idle machine has not been done.

Why an evaluation outside a Jacobian costs 1.5–2.5× a Jacobian column was not traced; caches the engine keeps when one parameter moves are the inference. Making trial steps and audits cheaper is now the larger share of wall time under forward differences.

It is not separated whether the central pass's few gains (at most 0.61 χ²_ν, all free fits in flat valleys) come from central differences or simply from restarting Levenberg–Marquardt with λ reset. A forward-difference final pass was not run.

Reach as the best exact χ² counts free fits beside held results. The two new misses of the recommended combination (cylinder-Pm-3m-on 2.6, sqbox-P4mmm-near 2.7) leave the reported held fit identical. Flat valleys along free extents (round 1's open issue) still make Δ noisy.

Forward differences changed one outcome (ellipsoid-P4m-on, held → free) by reaching a minimum 11.6 χ²_ν lower and less accurate. With exact lines, reach and accuracy part; whether this holds on track A's line model is open.

Everything here is on today's Lorentzian. The mechanisms should carry over (Jacobian halving, equivariant held frames, the start fill), but iterations, reach and the fill's value must be re-checked on track A's model.
The report (bodyShapeOf, about 20 % of a run) was not touched. Forward differences in its profiles (turnEsds) are untested.
In the six classes with 5 or more families, lowIndexAxes keeps the first 5 (P−1 has 13 families with indices up to 1). No start count was changed there, since more starts are excluded by the user.
Validation rows were not run or read.

reproduced: The today replica is exact. I re-ran sqbox-Pm-3-on and cylinder-Pm-3m-on with B's run.mjs, each in both method orders (today,nocov,fwd and the reverse). Every refinement's evaluations and χ² are bit-identical to the pilot and to sub1: today 3095 and 3146, nocov 2729, fwd 1614 and 1652 (check in B-verify against B/results/sub1 and pilot/results/screen).
symA reproduces bit-identically on cylinder-Pm-3m-on: 1378 evaluations, held 16949.54, best free 16947.60. Against fwd's 16943.18 that is Δ 2.60 at χ²_ν 1.697, as reported.

The headline sums, recomputed from the raw records by my own script (B-verify/indep.mjs) rather than score.mjs: bestC is symA in −3m, 6/m, 6/mmm, m−3 and m−3m and fwdH elsewhere, counted as search evaluations less the covOnly pass. 151 381 against 307 235 (0.493×); fwd 161 197 (0.525×); fwdC 163 051 (0.531×). Wall 55.3 against 98.7 min (0.560×), 43.1 against 76.9 s a run. All 11 per-class evaluation and wall ratios match.

The composition of 'best' holds. lowIndexAxes labels each axis by its Laue-orbit representative, so its axes are distinct families. It gives 5 axes in −1, 2/m, mmm, 4/m, 4/mmm and −3, 4 in −3m, 6/m and 6/mmm, and 3 in m−3 and m−3m. So symA and fwdH run the same code path in the six classes with no fill, and no deterministic start is equivalent to another under the class or the body.
Held dedupe: 29 of 124 held refinements are repeats in the fwd records, 2178 evaluations. fwdH real against derived differs in one row only (box-Pm-3-near, 8 evaluations).

The central pass: extents moved at most 4.45 % (spheroid-P2m-on) and under 0.4 % elsewhere; the frame turned at most 1.72° and the principal axis at most 1.06° (ellipsoid-P-3-generic). fwdC/fwd = 1.0115.
No result file under B/results is a validation row. All 77 screening rows are tuning rows.

Wall-time pairing, 4 rows run in both orders as concurrent process pairs. fwd/today was 0.570/0.668 (sqbox-Pm-3-on), 0.542/0.610 (cylinder-Pm-3m-on), 0.638/0.647 (ellcyl-Pm-3m-generic) and 0.712/0.629 (spheroid-P-3-near). Pooled over the 8 runs that is 0.62, against B's 0.645 on the same 4 rows. There is no consistent order bias, but a single row's paired ratio varies by up to 17 %.
Iterations per refinement, today against fwd on the 55 rows outside the sub-screen: full 14.4 against 14.9, held 8.6 against 9.0. That is near unchanged, as claimed (B-verify/iters.mjs).

problems.where: symA and symC against fwdH, and the 'best' and 'cuts' attributions: B/methods/var.mjs, starts 'distinct' and 'fz'. The report's (4), the symA and symC verdicts, the cuts verdict and best's Reach and Solids changed.
problems.problem: The symA and symC comparisons are not like-for-like in random numbers. One seeded stream feeds both the random fill and the later random turns, turned(): a 0.02 rad turn about a random axis before each polish and the refit. Dropping or redrawing the fill shifts that stream, so every polish and refit turn differs from fwdH's. Three results charged to the start cut come from this shift, not from the missing starts: the one reach loss ('cylinder-Pm-3m-on Δ 2.6 … symA's', 'It cost one free-fit miss'), symC's 'missed the same run by more … the fill's value was not coverage of the zone', and best's third changed solid (sphere-P6mmm-1).
problems.evidence: I added symAs: symA with the fill's random numbers drawn and thrown away (B-verify/var2.mjs, run2.mjs, variants2.mjs). On cylinder-Pm-3m-on it has the same 7 starts and the same full refinements as symA. Its polish, exact, held and refit are then identical to fwd's (48/43/53/37/64 evaluations), and it reaches 16943.18, Δ 0.00, in 1210 evaluations (symA 1363, fwdH* 1637). All of these refine from the same held fit, 16949.54; only the refit's random turn decides the free minimum: today 16943.22, fwd 16943.18, symA 16947.60, symC 16955.81. On 14 rows of the five classes (B-verify/cmp-symAs.mjs, symAs/*.json), symAs costs 0.869× fwdH*C against symA's 0.894×. On box-P6m-generic symA took 2189 evaluations against symAs' 1700. sphere-P6mmm-1 against today moves 1.16 % and 2.67° under symA (counted as changed) but 2.57 % and 1.74° under symAs (not changed by the 5 % / 2° rule). The start cut's own effect on reach, solids and cost is therefore not cleanly measured. On these rows, best's 56/63 reach and 3/63 changed solids include RNG artefacts.

tried.verdict: Kept. A pure saving: nothing it leaves out was ever read. Every later variant includes it.

tried.name: fwd (1)+(2)
tried.idea: Forward differences in every refinement of the search: one displaced point per non-linear column, reusing the state's pattern at v, and a backward point at an upper bound. No intermediate covariance. The returned fit's covariance is made once, with central differences.
tried.results: Sub-screen, 22 runs, paired in the same processes: 0.527× the evaluations (median per run 0.518) and 0.593× the wall time. Same outcome on 22/22, no solid changed, reach 22/22 (today 21/22). Iterations per refinement unchanged: brief 7.9 against 7.9, full 11.4 against 11.5. Full screening set, 77 runs: 161 197 against 307 235 evaluations (0.525×; median 0.519). Same outcome on 76/77: ellipsoid-P4m-on went from held to free, at a free minimum 11.6 χ²_ν (today's χ²_ν) below today's held fit. Solid changed on 2 of 63 kept runs. Reach 57/63 against today's 55/63 (best known over all methods). Medians: worst extent +42 % (90 %: +290 %), as today; thinnest +22 % against +20 %; axis 7.2° against 6.8°. Spheres: 11/11 the same.
tried.verdict: Kept: the core of the gain.

tried.name: fwdC: the central pass (2)
tried.idea: The user's condition: the minimum fwd returns is refined once more with central differences, and its covariance comes from that pass. This replaces the covariance-only pass. Both accountings come from one run: fwd is the run less the central pass, fwdC the run less the covOnly.
tried.results: 63 kept runs of the 77. Cost: 44 evaluations median (IQR 36–58, range 28–159), against 18 for the covariance alone, so +24 a run: 0.531× against 0.525×. Wall 0.599× against 0.594× (vs the pilot). One iteration median. χ² lowered by 0.0003 χ²_ν median, at most 0.61. Four runs moved by more than 0.1 χ²_ν and none by more than 1, all free fits: box-P4mmm-generic 0.61, sqbox-P6mmm-generic 0.25, ellipsoid-P-3-generic 0.17, box-Pmmm-on 0.14. Extents moved by at most 4.45 % (spheroid-P2m-on) and by under 0.4 % in every other run. Axes moved by at most 1.7°. No outcome changed.
tried.verdict: Kept, as the user asked. It costs 1.2 % of fwd and does not move the minimum, except in flat valleys along free extents.

tried.name: fwdH (3)
tried.idea: Held lattice frames de-duplicated by the harness's canonical(). A frame whose canonical form (R and dims) repeats an earlier one, modulo the Laue class and the body's symmetry, is not refined. Measured two ways: for real ('canon'), and as flags in fwd ('count': refined anyway and marked, so fwdH* = fwd less the marked evaluations). The held stage draws no random numbers, so skipping a frame leaves the later turns unchanged.
tried.results: Pilot logs: the 29 repeated frames end at the same χ² and evaluations as the first (to 0.01). The refinement is equivariant under the class's rotations. 77 runs: 29 of 124 held refinements repeat a frame modulo the class (heldcls.mjs). By class: 6/mmm 6, −3m 5, m−3 5, m−3m 4, 4/m 3, 4/mmm 3, −3 2, 6/m 1; none in −1, 2/m or mmm. Saving 2178 evaluations, 28 a run, 0.7 % of today (0.525× → 0.518×). Real against derived on 52 rows: 117 364 against 117 372 evaluations, the 8 in one row (box-Pm-3-near, where the refit starts from an equivalent frame). Outcomes and minima identical. Sub-screen wall 0.559× against fwd's 0.593×, but measured in another process. Round 1's axis-signs dedupe would catch 19 of the 29 (pilot reading).
tried.verdict: Kept: free, and by construction it changes no result.

tried.name: fwdB (2')
tried.idea: Forward differences only in the 8-iteration briefs; central differences in the full, polish, exact, held and refit refinements.
tried.results: Not run. fwd already reached today's minima on 22/22 with the same iteration counts, so central refinements after the briefs could only cost more.
tried.verdict: Dropped before running, for that reason.

tried.name: random-stream fix (correction of symA, symC and cuts)
tried.idea: One seeded stream feeds both the random fill and the later random turns: a 0.02 rad turn about a random axis before each polish and before the refit. The first symA and symC dropped or redrew the fill, which shifted that stream, so every polish and refit turn differed from fwdH's. The skeptic's finding is correct. Fix in var.mjs: 'distinct' and 'fz' now draw today's fill from the main stream and throw it away. 'fz' draws its candidates from a copy of the stream taken at the fill, so its first candidates are today's fill starts, in order. A start mode now differs from 'today' only in its starts. The first versions are kept as 'distinctShift' and 'fzShift' (variants symA0, symC0, cuts0). All three were re-run on the 35 rows of the five classes with a fill (tag symfix, 15 min). Elsewhere the fill is empty, nothing is drawn, and the first records stand. Scored with score.mjs --supersede, which keeps the first records in the best known as symA0, symC0 and cuts0.
tried.results:
Checks. 'today' still equals the pilot, and symA0, symC0 and cuts0 reproduce the first records bit for bit (sqbox-Pm-3-on, check-replica.mjs and check-legacy.mjs: 1/1 and 3/3). The new symA equals B-verify's symAs on its 14 rows (cmp-sym.mjs). The new symC keeps symC0's starts exactly (the same candidate stream: 17 draws in −3m and 6/m, 215–229 in 6/mmm and cubic) and differs only in the turns.

What the shift did, on the 35 rows (symA0 against symA):
- Cost: 55 183 against 54 809 evaluations (C accounting), with single runs up to +29 % (box-P6m-generic, 2189 against 1700).
- cylinder-Pm-3m-on: the miss of 2.6 χ²_ν was a turn artefact. Every method refines from the same held fit (16949.54), and the refit turn alone decides the free minimum: today 16943.22, fwd and symA 16943.18, symA0 16947.60, symC0 16955.81.
- sphere-P6mmm-1: against today it moves 1.16 %/2.67° under symA0 (counted as changed) and 2.57 %/1.74° under symA (not changed).
- box-Pm-3-near: symC0's best χ² (21134.35, Δ 0.00 against 0.16–0.19) also came from its turns. The fixed symC ends at fwd's 21134.76.
tried.verdict: Fixed at the root; every figure below for symA, symC, cuts and best is from the fixed runs. The spread between symA and symA0 measures the turn's own noise, which is a finding in itself (see why).

tried.name: symA (4)
tried.idea: Use symmetry to cut the starts: keep only the class's distinct low-index starts, 1 + 2 × families, with no random fill. lowIndexAxes already gives one axis per Laue family, and a plate and a needle along one family are not equivalent, so the only redundant starts are the random fill to 11. That fill exists only where the class has fewer than 5 families: −3m, 6/m and 6/mmm (4 families: 9 starts + 2 random) and m−3 and m−3m (3 families: 7 + 4 random). Nothing changes in the other six classes. Run with fwd, the central pass and canon; the turns are fwdH's (fixed stream).
tried.results:
Sub-screen (the 10 runs of the five classes): 0.436× today's evaluations against fwdH's 0.517× (0.441× against 0.521× with the central pass). All 35 runs of those classes: 54 151 against 63 894 for fwdH* (−15.2 %); with the central pass 54 809 against 64 675 (0.847×).

By class, evaluations against the pilot with the central pass: −3m 0.45, 6/m 0.49, 6/mmm 0.47, m−3 0.43, m−3m 0.36. fwd's are 0.52, 0.54, 0.54, 0.57 and 0.53.

On the 35 runs:
- Outcome the same on 35/35, including 5/5 early rejections.
- Reach 25/27, the same as fwd (the misses ellcyl-P6mmm-on 59.4 and ellcyl-Pm-3-near 2.6 are fwd's and today's too).
- Solids changed 1/26, the same run as fwd (ellcyl-P-3m1-near).
- The best exact χ² equals fwd's (to 0.01) in 33/35 runs. The other two: sqbox-P6mmm-generic 0.36 χ²_ν lower, and sqbox-Pm-3m-near 0.32 higher (rejected both ways).

Pilot reading: random starts were among the 3 best briefs in 17 of 35 runs and were the best brief in 4.
tried.verdict: Kept in the recommended combination: −15 % in five classes, with no loss of reach, outcome or solid. Its gain is limited to those five classes.

tried.name: symC (4)
tried.idea: Random starts restricted to the fundamental zone, with the count scaled to what the zone leaves room for. A random start is drawn as today but kept only when its most telling axis lies at least 20° from every earlier start's, modulo the class's rotations (axes without sign; for a cylinder or spheroid, the axis alone). At most today's count, and 200 draws a slot. Fixed stream: the candidates come from a copy, and the turns are fwdH's.
tried.results: Fill kept: 2 in −3m and 6/m (17 draws), 1 in 6/mmm and 1 in cubic (215–229 draws). Sub-screen, 10 runs, against the pilot with the central pass: 0.489× the evaluations, against symA's 0.441× and fwdH's 0.521×. Outcome 10/10. Reach 9/10. It misses cylinder-Pm-3m-on by Δ 1.1 (the first version 3.7), in the free fit only; the held result is the same as today's. Its extra start changed the brief ranking and the full ends, and its polish then took 185 + 113 evaluations against fwd's 48 + 43, ending at 16945.08 against 16943.18.
tried.verdict: Rejected. It costs more than symA and reaches less: the fill's value was not coverage of the zone.

tried.name: fullDrop (4b)
tried.idea: Full refinements only from distinct brief ends. A brief end among the 3 best that is the same solid as a better one (sameSolid modulo the class and the body: 8°, e^0.25) is not refined fully. Prompted by the pilot logs: 78 of 210 full refinements started from a duplicate, and 69 of those 78 ended at the same solid as the first.
tried.results: Sub-screen: 0.482× against fwdH's 0.519×. Reach 21/22: ellipsoid-P-3-generic Δ 1.2, with its solid changed. On the 77, inside 'cuts', 80 full refinements were dropped in 52 runs. Those runs carry every serious loss: box-Pmmm-on Δ 21 → 191 χ²_ν (solid changed by 21 %), box-P4mmm-generic 0.0 → 3.1, ellipsoid-P-3-generic 0.4 → 1.2, and spheroid-P2m-on's solid changed by 46 % at Δ 0.19.
tried.verdict: Rejected. A brief end after 8 iterations is not converged, and two ends 8°/28 % apart can lead to different minima.

tried.name: fullRep (4b)
tried.idea: Round 1's dedupFull: the duplicate brief end is replaced by the next distinct one, so 3 full refinements are kept.
tried.results: Sub-screen: 0.563× against fwdH's 0.519× (+8 %). Reach 22/22, the same as fwdH. One solid changed.
tried.verdict: Rejected for this track: it adds cost and buys no reach here.

tried.name: cuts (finalist)
tried.idea: fwd + nocov + the central pass + held canon + symA + fullDrop: every cut together. Re-run with the fixed stream in the five fill classes; in the six others it is unchanged (nothing is drawn).
tried.results: 77 runs: 139 004 evaluations with the central pass (0.452×; 0.446× without). Wall 0.499× the pilot's. Outcome the same on 76/77 (the same ellipsoid-P4m-on change). Solid changed 6/63. Reach 55/63, with box-Pmmm-on at Δ 190.8. Every loss beyond best's is in a class with no fill, so it is fullDrop's alone: box-Pmmm-on 190.8, box-P4mmm-generic 3.1, ellipsoid-P-3-generic 1.2. The same holds for the 4 extra changed solids: box-Pmmm-on, sqbox-Pmmm-generic, ellipsoid-P-3-generic and spheroid-P2m-on (mmm, mmm, −3 and 2/m). On the 35 fill-class runs, cuts reaches what symA reaches (25/27).
tried.verdict: Rejected because of fullDrop. Without fullDrop it becomes 'best'.

tried.name: best (finalist, recommended)
tried.idea: fwd + nocov + the central pass + held canon + symA, as one configuration. It ran as symA (tag symfix, fixed stream) in the 5 classes whose starts it changes (35 runs), and as fwdH in the 6 where it changes none (42 runs: 12 in sub2, 30 in held30). There the fill is empty, so the stream fix changes nothing. All are real runs.
tried.results: See 'best'.
tried.verdict: Recommended.

tried.name: profile (mechanism check, not a variant)
tried.idea: Time spent inside phasePattern, and inside the Jacobians against elsewhere, for today and fwd. Engine copy hp/ adds a timer around phasePattern and a flag inside the Jacobians, with no arithmetic change.
tried.results:
Five profile pairs on 3 rows (prof.out, prof2.out):
- 96–98 % of the search's time is in pattern evaluations; the work outside them is 1.6–2.8 % (today) and 2.3–4.4 % (fwd).
- An evaluation outside a Jacobian (trial step, FCJ audit, covariance) costs 1.5–2.5× a Jacobian column: box-Pm-3-near 20.1 against 13.5 ms, ellcyl-P2m-generic 48.6 against 19.5 ms.
- Their share of the evaluations rises under fwd: from 16 % to 27 % (box-Pm-3-near) and from 6 % to 12 % (ellcyl-P2m-generic).
- At today's per-evaluation costs, that change of mix alone raises the mean cost per evaluation by 5 % (box-Pm-3-near, 14.5 → 15.3 ms) and by 8 % (ellcyl-P2m-generic, 21.3 → 23.1 ms).
- The measured rise over the five pairs is 4.5–23 %: +4.5 % (ellcyl-P2m-generic, prof2), +8.9 %, +16.9 %, +20.6 % and +23 %.
- Load noise is as large as the effect: the same fwd search of ellcyl-P2m-generic took 56.8 s in one profile run and 49.0 s in the other (16 % apart).
tried.verdict: Explains part of why wall time falls less than evaluations under forward differences. The mix accounts for 5–8 of the 12 % by which fwd's paired wall ratio (0.593×) exceeds its evaluation ratio (0.527×). The rest is within the measured load noise.

result.best:
The recommended combination:
- forward differences in every refinement of the search, with no intermediate covariance;
- the returned fit refined once more with central differences, its covariance taken from that pass;
- held frames de-duplicated by canonical();
- only the class's distinct low-index starts (no random fill). That is 7 starts in m−3 and m−3m, 9 in −3m, 6/m and 6/mmm, and 11 as today in the other six classes.

In the engine the fill's random numbers can still be drawn and thrown away, as here, so that the polish and refit turns stay today's.

All figures below are on the full 77-run screening set, against today's run in the pilot (score.mjs --supersede; symA from the fixed stream).
- **Evaluations:** 151 007 against 307 235 (0.492×; median per run 0.499). By part: forward differences + no covariance 0.525×; central pass +0.006×; held dedupe −0.007×; symmetric starts −0.032×.
- **Search time:** 42.4 s against 76.9 s a run, or 54.5 against 98.7 min summed: 0.552× the pilot's wall time.
  - This was measured under heavier load (our 2 processes beside another agent's 2–3 on 4 vCPUs).
  - Against the today replica on the 22 sub-screen runs it is 0.535×, from separate processes. Forward differences alone, paired in the same processes, give 0.593×.
- **By class, evaluations / wall against the pilot:** −1 0.50/0.58, 2/m 0.50/0.55, mmm 0.52/0.59, 4/m 0.51/0.57, 4/mmm 0.58/0.63, −3 0.53/0.56, −3m 0.45/0.50, 6/m 0.49/0.54, 6/mmm 0.47/0.50, m−3 0.43/0.44, m−3m 0.36/0.36.
- **Outcome:** the same on 76/77, including all 11 spheres (3 kept, 8 rejected) and all 7 early rejections.
  - The one change: ellipsoid-P4m-on went from held to free. Forward differences found a free minimum 11.7 χ²_ν below today's held fit. It is less accurate: longest extent +33 % against +14 %, axis 4.5° against 0.0°.
- **Reach** (Δ ≤ 1 against the best exact χ² of all methods run): 57/63 against today's 55/63, the same as fwd.
  - Gained: box-P4mmm-generic, ellcyl-P6m-generic, ellipsoid-P4m-on.
  - Lost: sqbox-P4mmm-near, Δ 2.7. This is a free fit beside a held result identical to today's.
  - The earlier loss on cylinder-Pm-3m-on was a random-stream artefact; that run now reaches Δ 0.00.
- **Reported fit's χ²** (the returned fit, after the central pass, against today's; in χ²_ν of the best known fit): within 0.1 in 54/63 kept runs.
  - Lower in 6: ellipsoid-P4m-on −11.68, box-P4mmm-generic −1.19, ellcyl-P6m-generic −1.05, sqbox-P6mmm-generic −0.35, box-P6m-generic −0.29, ellipsoid-P-3-generic −0.17.
  - Higher in 3: box-Pmmm-on +1.81, ellcyl-P-3-on +0.83, ellcyl-P-3m1-near +0.16.
- **Solids changed** (more than 5 % in an extent or 2° in the axis): 2 of 63, the same two as fwd.
  - ellipsoid-P4m-on, the outcome change above.
  - ellcyl-P-3m1-near: an equivalent minimum with the height on another extent, at Δ 0.01 against today's 0.03.
- **Accuracy medians:** worst extent +42 % (90 %: +290 %), as today; thinnest +22 % against +20 %; axis 6.8° against 6.8°.
- **(5), round 1 checked in every class:** forward differences + no intermediate covariance (with the central pass) give 0.50–0.58× the evaluations, 7 runs per class, which confirms the halving.
  - Wall time does not halve: 0.56–0.72× against the pilot, and 0.52–0.71× paired (2 runs per class).
  - Cubic reproduces round 1: m−3m 0.53× the evaluations, 0.60–0.63× the wall time.
result.why:
**Where the evaluations go.** Today's search spends:
- 60 % of its evaluations in the 11 briefs (8 iterations each, about 220 evaluations);
- 23 % in the 3 full refinements;
- about 10 % in the held frames;
- the rest in polish, exact and refit.

An iteration is a Jacobian (2 evaluations per non-linear column, central) plus about 1.2 trial steps. Every refinement also ended with a covariance: 1 + 2 evaluations per non-linear parameter, about 10 % of a brief.

**(1) No intermediate covariance.** The covariance is made after convergence, and only the returned fit's is read. Dropping it cannot change any step: 0.908× the evaluations and identical minima on 22/22 runs.

**(2) Forward differences.** They halve each Jacobian.
- The iteration counts did not change at the median (brief 7.9; full 11.4 against 11.5), and the minima were today's on 22/22 runs.
- Where the path diverged, the fit ended at the same χ² (cylinder-P4mmm-on: 45 against 32 full iterations).
- The ratio by class is 0.49–0.58. It is highest in 4/mmm and m−3, where trial steps and audits weigh more in a run.

**Why wall time falls less than evaluations.** 96–98 % of the search's time is in pattern evaluations. An evaluation outside a Jacobian (trial step, FCJ audit, covariance) costs 1.5–2.5× a Jacobian column. Forward differences halve only the cheap Jacobian evaluations, so the dear ones become a larger share: 16 % → 27 % on box-Pm-3-near, 6 % → 12 % on ellcyl-P2m-generic. At today's costs this mix alone raises the mean cost per evaluation by 5–8 %, which accounts for 5–8 of the 12 % by which fwd's paired wall ratio (0.593×) exceeds its evaluation ratio (0.527×). The measured rise over five profile pairs is 4.5–23 %, and the same search's time varied by 16 % between two profile runs, so the remainder is within load noise. The higher cost outside the Jacobians is inferred to come from caches the engine keeps when only one parameter moves; this was not traced.

**The central pass.** On a forward-difference minimum it costs 1 iteration (44 evaluations median) and moves χ² by 0.0003 χ²_ν median: the forward and central minima are the same point. Its few moves (at most 0.61 χ²_ν, 4.5 % in an extent, 1.7° in an axis) are all free fits in flat valleys, where the shift test had stopped. Its marginal cost over the covariance it replaces is 24 evaluations a run.

**(3) Held frames.**
- The refinement is equivariant under the class's rotations, so equivalent frames end at the same χ² in the same number of evaluations, and skipping them changes nothing.
- They exist only where a rotation of the class maps one candidate frame onto another, which is in the eight classes with a 3-, 4- or 6-fold axis: 6/mmm 6, −3m 5, m−3 5, m−3m 4, 4/m 3, 4/mmm 3, −3 2, 6/m 1. That is 29 of 124 held refinements on the 77 runs, and none in −1, 2/m or mmm.
- The held refinements are a small stage, so the saving is small: 28 evaluations a run.

**(4) Symmetry and starts.**
- lowIndexAxes already gives one axis per Laue family, and a plate and a needle along one family are different starts, so no deterministic start is equivalent to another.
- The only symmetry redundancy is the random fill to 11. It exists only where the class has fewer than 5 low-index families: 2 random starts in −3m, 6/m and 6/mmm, and 4 in cubic. That is how higher symmetry already lowers the number of distinct starts.
- Dropping the fill saves 15 % of the search in those five classes, which then run at 36–49 % of today's evaluations. With the turns held fixed it costs nothing measurable: the same best χ² as fwd in 33/35 runs (the other two ±0.3 χ²_ν), and the same reach (25/27), outcomes (35/35) and solids.
- Restricting the fill to the fundamental zone, at 20° from every start, reaches less (9/10 against 10/10) and costs more than dropping the fill (0.489× against 0.441×). A uniform random rotation is already uniform in the zone modulo symmetry, and the deterministic starts reach the fill's basins anyway.

**The random turn is a noise source of its own.** A 0.02 rad turn about a random axis precedes each polish and the refit. In flat valleys it alone decides which free minimum is returned. On cylinder-Pm-3m-on, every method refines from the same held fit (16949.54), and the refit ends at 16943.18–16955.81 depending only on the turn: up to 7.5 χ²_ν of the best fit. Shifting the stream changed cost by up to 29 % in a run (box-P6m-generic) and moved a sphere kept as a box by about 1–2 % and 1–3°. Comparisons between start modes are therefore like-for-like only with the turns held fixed, as they now are.

**(4b) Full refinements from distinct brief ends.** The 3 best brief ends are often duplicates by an 8°/28 % test (52 of 77 runs). Dropping the duplicates looks safe on the pilot logs (69 of 78 ended alike) but costs reach on the 77, up to 191 χ²_ν on box-Pmmm-on. Briefs of 8 iterations are not converged, and ends that close can still lead to different minima.
open: Skeptic's points, checked: all four are correct and fixed. (a) The random stream: fixed in var.mjs, re-run and re-scored. symA now equals B-verify's symAs on its 14 rows, and the reach loss, the third changed solid and symC's larger miss are gone or reduced. (b) The reach bullet now uses bestC (the returned fit): 54/63 within 0.1 χ²_ν, 6 lower, box-Pmmm-on +1.81. score.mjs now prints this comparison for every variant, so it no longer comes from a separate reading. (c) The per-class count of repeated held frames is corrected: 1–6 per class in 8 classes (heldcls.mjs). (d) The profile range is corrected: 4.5–23 % measured, 5–8 % from the mix alone, and load noise of up to 16 % between two runs of one search.

Wall time was measured under load: another agent's 2 processes ran beside our 2 on 4 vCPUs, during the symfix runs as before. Only fwd against today is paired in the same process (22 runs). The recommended combination's wall time (0.535–0.552×) comes from separate processes, or from comparison with the pilot's quieter run. The skeptic's pairing on 4 rows run in both orders gives 0.62 pooled against B's 0.645, with a single row's paired ratio varying by up to 17 %. A paired timing on an idle machine has not been done.

Why an evaluation outside a Jacobian costs 1.5–2.5× a Jacobian column was not traced; caches the engine keeps when one parameter moves are an inference. Under forward differences, those trial steps and audits are now the larger share of wall time, so making them cheaper is the next lever.

The 0.02 rad random turn before each polish and the refit decides the free minimum in flat valleys: up to 7.5 χ²_ν of spread on cylinder-Pm-3m-on from the turn alone. Reach counts free fits beside held results, so Δ near 1–3 χ²_ν is partly turn noise. That holds for today's search too; it is round 1's flat-valley issue. Whether a deterministic turn, or two turns with the better kept, would remove this noise is untested.

It is not separated whether the central pass's few gains (at most 0.61 χ²_ν, all free fits in flat valleys) come from central differences or simply from restarting Levenberg–Marquardt with λ reset. A forward-difference final pass was not run.

Forward differences changed one outcome (ellipsoid-P4m-on, held → free) by reaching a minimum 11.7 χ²_ν lower and less accurate. With exact lines, reach and accuracy part ways; whether this holds on track A's line model is open.

Everything here uses today's Lorentzian. The mechanisms should carry over (Jacobian halving, equivariant held frames, the start fill), but iterations, reach and the fill's value must be re-checked on track A's model.
The report (bodyShapeOf, about 20 % of a run) was not touched. Forward differences in its profiles (turnEsds) are untested.
In the six classes with 5 or more families, lowIndexAxes keeps the first 5 (P−1 has 13 families with indices up to 1). No start count was changed there, since the user excluded adding starts.
Validation rows were not run or read. All 35 symfix rows and the legacy row are tuning rows of the screening set.
